_comment: LIVE-ONLY registry. The 9 downloaded-video demo cameras were moved to cameras.sample.json so only real live camera(s) are analyzed. Add more live cameras by copying the cam 1 block with the camera's RTSP URL. Restore the full demo set with: cp cameras.sample.json cameras.json

cameras.name: Cam 1 - Lobby
cameras._deterrence_comment: After-hours intrusion -> physical deterrence. driver 'log' only logs (safe default); switch to 'isapi' (Hikvision-OEM built-in strobe+speaker) or 'onvif' (external siren on alarm-out relay) AFTER a live capability probe of the camera (scripts/probe_camera.py). See deterrence.py.

_topology_comment: Single live camera — no cross-camera topology yet. Add edges here when more live cameras are connected.
